entries.708e978496ef5afc: It has set a medium- to long-term vision, "From Operations to Solutions," aiming to build the ability to draw out and resolve true customer needs through dialogue with customers, on the foundation of operational capability it has developed. It has set B-to-B logistics as its target market, and aims to deliver value in the machine tool, precision instrument, and medical equipment fields, where its strength in packaging technology can be applied. Under the three-year medium-term management plan formulated in May 2026 (fiscal year ending March 2027 to fiscal year ending March 2029), it has set as key measures expanding domestic logistics bases, improving profitability through maximum use of existing assets, and maximizing added value through warehouse-based high value-added services in the United States, and it states that it promotes sustainability as a foundational strategy.
